relay_model.name: ZENITH_BISECTOR_DUAL_CHANNEL_RELAY
relay_model.rule: Freeze the pyramid/retransmitter central axis to local zenith and require the internal LOVE-EDEM bisector to coincide with that zenith. The two target rays then lie symmetrically on opposite sides of the zenith.

intrinsic_earth_locus.principle: If the celestial internal bisector is local zenith, observer geocentric latitude equals the bisector declination. Longitude is not intrinsic; it is fixed only after choosing sidereal time/date.
intrinsic_earth_locus.geographic_interpretation: Without a frozen time the solution is a latitude circle, not a unique terrestrial site.

frozen_timestamp_solution.reason: Inherited frozen January reference from the prior Giza/Kamil geometry receipts; not selected after this bisector result.

null_and_specificity_control.geometry_only_question: For two independently isotropic random sky directions, what fraction have angular separation in the interval that would place both symmetric zenith-bisector channels within 0.25 deg of 44.5 deg altitude?
null_and_specificity_control.important_boundary: This is a nominal geometry-only probability, not a discovery p-value. LOVE/EDEM and the pyramid operator arise from prior project selection, so trials/look-elsewhere effects are not accounted for.

comparison_to_kamil_rigid_gate.explanation: The Kamil rigid gate asked whether an unchanged cardinal Giza operator translated to Kamil targets LOVE/EDEM; it failed. This bisector model instead solves for the Earth locus where the LOVE-EDEM pair itself becomes symmetric around local zenith. It therefore defines a new relay-location hypothesis and cannot retroactively convert Kamil into a pass.

reverse_pass.BACK: Start from the frozen LOVE and EDEM ICRS vectors and remove Giza/Kamil labels.
reverse_pass.LEFT: Force the bisector to local zenith; this fixes terrestrial latitude to bisector declination.
reverse_pass.RIGHT: Freeze the inherited January timestamp to resolve longitude without post-hoc time search.
reverse_pass.FORWARD_AGAIN: Transform LOVE and EDEM into local alt/az and test a symmetric two-channel 44.5-degree reference.
reverse_pass.BACK_AGAIN: Preserve the distinction between deterministic geometry, a relay-location hypothesis, archaeology, and physical causation.

next_gate.name: LOVE_EDEM_BISECTOR_LATITUDE_LAND_ARCHAEOLOGY_AND_MELT_SITE_BLIND_SCAN_V1
next_gate.rule: Before looking for culturally interesting sites, freeze a search corridor around latitude -3.865418 deg using the inherited 0.25 deg angular tolerance transformed to a geographic-latitude band. Then query independently catalogued pyramidal/monumental structures, impact/melt sites and geological anomalies. Do not choose longitude by archaeology first.
next_gate.recommended_control: Compare hit density against matched random latitude circles and rotate the LOVE-EDEM pair randomly while preserving its separation.
